title: Redesign macOS tweak workflow
author: herasymchyk-oleksii
body:
## Summary

- Replace the duplicate header and full-screen side menu with a single desktop navigation bar.
- Present tweak install and removal as explicit, stateful actions; keep selected changes visible while searching.
- Move installation settings into the main workflow and refresh the CASDK layout.
- Keep the existing tweak IDs and compile handlers.

## Verification

- Built and launched the macOS x64 application.
- Checked navigation, tweak selection, Tools and Resources menus, and CASDK layout in the running app.
- Verified the app code signature and the generated DMG checksum.

The branch includes the macOS startup and Wi-Fi AP fix from #230 because the redesign was developed on top of it. Vehicle installation was not tested.

@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+# Interface direction
+
+<!-- impeccable:design-schema 1 -->
+
+MZD-AIO uses a restrained light desktop interface. The app is a working utility: users should first see where to choose tweaks and where to compile USB files.
+
+- **Surface:** soft gray canvas, white working areas, hairline dividers, and a white navigation bar.
+- **Type:** macOS system sans for controls and reading; the MZD-AIO name remains the identity anchor.
+- **Color:** deep navy text, muted blue for selection and the primary action, green only for successful install selection, red for removal or destructive states.
+- **Structure:** quiet top navigation, clear compile action, quick selections, searchable tweak cards, and a persistent selection summary.
+- **Controls:** familiar rounded buttons and inputs, obvious focus rings, and consistent 36–44 px targets where layout permits.
+- **Density:** compact enough for many tweaks, with 12–16 px spacing within groups and larger gaps between work areas.
+- **Motion:** only short functional hover and focus transitions; no decorative animations.

@@ -0,0 +1,39 @@
+# Product
+
+<!-- impeccable:product-schema 1 -->
+
+## Platform
+
+macOS desktop (Electron)
+
+## Users
+
+Mazda MZD infotainment owners preparing tweak installation or recovery files on a Mac.
+
+## Product Purpose
+
+MZD-AIO lets users select infotainment tweaks, configure related options, and compile files for a USB drive. It also provides autorun and recovery workflows.
+
+## Operating Context
+
+The desktop app runs in Electron. Users choose tweaks and compile a folder of files that they copy to a USB drive for use with a Mazda infotainment system.
+
+## Capabilities and Constraints
+
+- Preserve existing tweak IDs, labels, selection behavior, compile actions, and autorun/recovery workflows.
+- The interface uses AngularJS, W3 CSS, Bootstrap, and local HTML/CSS assets.
+- A visual redesign must not alter generated files or the vehicle installation logic.
+
+## Brand Commitments
+
+Keep the MZD-AIO name and Mazda-related product context. The user requested a restrained, light macOS visual direction.
+
+## Evidence on Hand
+
+The repository contains the application UI, tweak definitions, source assets, and packaging configuration. No vehicle test is available here.
+
+## Product Principles
+
+- Make tweak discovery and selection easy to scan.
+- Make the path to USB compilation clear.
+- Keep advanced recovery tools findable without letting them dominate the main workflow.
